text_block_list.text: Alas! The situation is grave, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My passion for racing has begun to
swell. I fear I
cannot contain it much
longer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Lalalaaa! ♪ The Centurial Overlord shall
prevail
this day! ♪ That being me, I must
do say! ♪
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The power to make all cower—I'll
trounce any
foe! ♪ That is I! T.M. Opera
Ooo! ♪
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I let her impulses run free until she
elatedly heads
for the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
